code_examples.section: ltm rule command ANTIFRAUD alert device id
code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

ANTIFRAUD::alert_device_id
       Deprecated: Returns flash GUID.

SYNOPSIS
DESCRIPTION
       Returns flash GUID.

RETURN VALUE
       Returns flash GUID.

VALID DURING
       ANTIFRAUD_ALERT

EXAMPLES
	when ANTIFRAUD_ALERT {
	    log local0. "Alert device ID: [ANTIFRAUD::alert_device_id]."
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-12.0.0
		   --First introduced the command.  @BIGIP-13.0.0
		   --Deprecated in favor of ANTIFRAUD::alert_fingerprint.

BIG-IP							    2022-04-12							  iRule(1)
